# Welcome {.unnumbered}

::: {.alkahest-excerpt-placeholder}
:::

Alkahest lets you write one Markdown manuscript and produce a website, an EPUB,
and print-oriented PDFs without maintaining separate source files for each
format. This guide is itself an Alkahest book: every command and file described
here is part of the same minimal author workflow you will use.

If you want to begin immediately, run these commands from an Alkahest book:

```sh
make doctor
make draft
```

Then open `_build/full/html/index.html`. Edit a chapter in
`manuscript/chapters/`, run `make draft` again, and keep writing.

The chapters explain how to:

1. understand the small author-facing repository;
2. add and organize manuscript content;
3. write code, mathematics, tables, figures, notes, and citations;
4. validate and build every output; and
5. share a one- or two-chapter excerpt without exposing the full manuscript.

You do not need to understand the publishing engine before writing. Files under
`_build/.work/` are disposable implementation details.
